info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to amuse oneself, to enjoy, to play, to gamble, to make a noise

examples: 'yad didyavaH pftanAsu prakrIqAn' (f॰4.41.11). prakrIqanti viharanti, Kelanti.
yErindraH prakrIqate padGozESCAyayA saha (aTarva॰5.21.8). AtmAnaM vinodayatItyarTaH.
'prakrIqituM siMhaSiSuM balAtkAreRa karzati (SA॰7).
'tasya saNkrIqamAnasya mahAdevasya DImataH. SitikaRWasya devasya divyaM varzaSataM gatam' (rA॰1.36.6).. saNkrIqamAnasya=ramamARasya=vihAramanuBavataH. nArTaH samA.
'haraH saNkrIqamAnaSca umayA saha parvate' (rA॰1.47.10).
citraM saNkrIqamAnAstAH krIqanErviviDEH (rA॰1.9.14). ukto'rTaH.
'saNkrIqanti SakawAni' (pA॰1.3.21 sUtravfttO). kUjantItyarTaH.
'saNkrIqate Kale rAmA nage meGo'mbu muYcati' (bf0 ka0 ko0 58.29). saNkrIqate krIqati Kelati. Kale iti sAmIpye saptamI.
'tAsAM saNkrIqamAnAnAmeva vAditraniHsvanaH' (rA0 3.11.20). ukto'rTaH.
'yaTAtmatantro BagavAnvikrIqatyAtmamAyayA' (BA0 pu0 2.8.23). vikrIqati viharati. anAyastastAstA lIlAH samAcaratItyarTaH.
'vikrIqito yaTEvAhaM krIqAmfga ivADamaH' (BA0 pu0 6.2.37). vikrIqitaH krIqanakatAM nItaH.
'vikrIqya suciraM BImo rAkzasena sahAnaGa. nijaGAna mahAvIryastaM tadA…' (BA0 3.56).. vikrIqya=prahasya, narmavacanamudIrya.
'AkrIqamAno hfzwAtmA' (BA0 vana0 146.27). krIqan ityarTaH. pumAn AkrIqa udyAnamityamaraH.
'rudrasyAkrIqasadfSaH saMhAraH sarvadehinAm' (BA0 droRa0 124.44). AkrIqaH krIqanaM krIqA.
'tato gatvodyAnaM yaTAsuKamAkrIqya' (avi0 1). AkrIqya krIqitvA.
'AkrIqatAmaruRapAdasaroruhAByAmArdre madIyahfdaye BuvanArdramojaH' (kfzRAmfte Slo0 15). AkrIqatAM samantAt svEraM kIqatu viharatu.
'tasyAScatvAri catvAryakzarARi nikrIqayanniva gAyati' (lAwyA0 SrO0 7.12.9).
'ta enamatyakrIqan' (tE0 brA0 1.6.7). dyUtakriyayA devanenAtyaSeratetyAha.
'yEH parikrIqase sIte viSvastErmfgapotakEH' (rA0 3.61.5). parikrIqase paritaH krIqasi.
'marutastamaBitaH paricikrIquH' (Sa0 brA0 2.5.2.20).
'parikrIqasva sAnuzu' (Bawwi0 8.10).

'sAmAtyaH samparikrIqan kAmasya vaSamAgataH' (rA0 4.30.16). samparikrIqan prahasan, narma sevamAnaH. sAmAtyaparizat krIqan pAnamevopasevate iti pAWAntaram. idaM ca 30.79 ityatra dAkziRAtyakoSezu drazwavyam.
'upakrIqanti tAnrAjan SuBAScApsarasAM gaRAH' (BA0 anu0 81.30). upakrIqanti upetya krIqanti samIpe krIqanti. upasargavaSAt sakarmakatvam.
